meta.title: Currency allocation of foreign exchange reserves as disclosed by the central banks themselves
meta.note: Shares in per cent of the foreign exchange reserves (gold excluded unless 'gold' says 'included', in which case GLD is a share). 'quality': official = the percentages are printed in the source; computed = derived from amounts the source prints; benchmark = the published target allocation, not actual holdings; exposure = a balance-sheet currency exposure, not a reserve allocation; secondary = official figures confirmed only through the press; compiled = taken from the BOFIT dataset (Laser, Mihailov and Weidner 2024), not from the central bank directly. Currencies: USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CNY, CAD, AUD, GLD (gold), OTH (all others).

notDisclosed.JPN: The Ministry of Finance and the Bank of Japan publish no currency shares; only the SDR-basket split in the IMF template.
notDisclosed.SGP: The Monetary Authority of Singapore last wrote (2021/22) that about three quarters of the reserves are in dollars, euro, yen and sterling, the dollar forming the bulk; no figures since.
notDisclosed.IND: The Reserve Bank of India publishes the split by instrument, not by currency; the currency weights are set with the government and not published.
notDisclosed.IDN: Bank Indonesia publishes no currency split.
notDisclosed.THA: The Bank of Thailand publishes no currency split; only the SDR-basket split in the IMF template.
notDisclosed.MYS: Bank Negara Malaysia publishes no currency split; the IMF template shows about a quarter outside the SDR-basket currencies.
notDisclosed.SAU: The Saudi Central Bank publishes no currency split and leaves the IMF template's currency lines blank.
notDisclosed.GBR: The Exchange Equalisation Account's accounts give the reserves by region of issuer, not by currency; the allocation is confidential.
notDisclosed.FRA: The Banque de France says only that the reserves are principally in US dollars.
notDisclosed.HUN: The Magyar Nemzeti Bank names its bond currencies but publishes no shares; the exposure is basically in euro.
notDisclosed.TUR: The Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye publishes only the split between foreign exchange and gold; the last currency split is a one-off figure for 2017.
notDisclosed.CHN: SAFE disclosed only the dollar share, last for end-2019 (55 per cent), in a box that its 2024 and 2025 annual reports no longer carry; the IMF template gives the SDR-basket split.

notDisclosed_no.JPN: Finansdepartementet og Bank of Japan publiserer ingen valutaandeler; bare SDR-kurvefordelingen i IMFs reservemal.
notDisclosed_no.SGP: Monetary Authority of Singapore skrev sist (2021/22) at om lag tre firedeler av reservene er i dollar, euro, yen og pund, med dollar som den største; ingen tall siden.
notDisclosed_no.IND: Reserve Bank of India publiserer fordelingen etter instrument, ikke etter valuta; valutavektene fastsettes sammen med regjeringen og publiseres ikke.
notDisclosed_no.THA: Bank of Thailand publiserer ingen valutafordeling; bare SDR-kurvefordelingen i IMFs reservemal.
notDisclosed_no.MYS: Bank Negara Malaysia publiserer ingen valutafordeling; IMFs reservemal viser om lag en firedel utenfor SDR-kurvens valutaer.
notDisclosed_no.SAU: Den saudiarabiske sentralbanken publiserer ingen valutafordeling og lar valutalinjene i IMFs reservemal stå tomme.
notDisclosed_no.GBR: Regnskapet for Exchange Equalisation Account gir reservene etter utsteders region, ikke etter valuta; allokeringen er fortrolig.
notDisclosed_no.FRA: Banque de France sier bare at reservene hovedsakelig er i amerikanske dollar.
notDisclosed_no.HUN: Magyar Nemzeti Bank navngir obligasjonsvalutaene, men publiserer ingen andeler; eksponeringen er i hovedsak i euro.
notDisclosed_no.TUR: Den tyrkiske sentralbanken publiserer bare fordelingen mellom valuta og gull; siste valutafordeling er et enkeltstående tall for 2017.
notDisclosed_no.CHN: SAFE oppga bare dollarandelen, sist for utgangen av 2019 (55 prosent), i en ramme som årsrapportene for 2024 og 2025 ikke lenger har; IMFs reservemal gir SDR-kurvefordelingen.

meta.verified: Every entry checked against the cited document on 18 November 2026 (figures as printed, or arithmetic on printed amounts); 'secondary' entries could not be opened.

NOR.note: The fixed-income portfolio (NOK 528.8 bn, table 3 of the quarterly report); the equity portfolio (NOK 145.6 bn) has its own currency table (dollar 73, euro 8, yen 7 per cent) and the petroleum buffer portfolio (NOK 53.2 bn) no currency split.

source.title: Norges Bank, Management of the foreign exchange reserves, Q3 2026

NOR.note_no: Renteporteføljen (528,8 mrd. kroner, tabell 3 i kvartalsrapporten); aksjeporteføljen (145,6 mrd. kroner) har egen valutatabell (dollar 73, euro 8, yen 7 prosent), og petroleumsbufferporteføljen (53,2 mrd. kroner) har ingen valutafordeling.

SWE.note: Computed from the annual report's note 3 (balances with banks, loans and security investments by currency, SEK million, before hedging); the strategic allocation in force since April 2025 and unchanged for 2026 is USD 70, EUR 17.5, GBP 5, AUD 5, NOK 2.5 (table 7).

source.title: Sveriges Riksbank, Annual Report 2025, and the decision on the strategic allocation for 2026

SWE.note_no: Regnet ut fra årsrapportens note 3 (tilgodehavender hos banker, utlån og verdipapirer per valuta, millioner kroner, før sikring); den strategiske allokeringen som gjelder fra april 2025 og er uendret for 2026, er USD 70, EUR 17,5, GBP 5, AUD 5, NOK 2,5 (tabell 7).

DNK.note: Claims on non-residents by currency of denomination (annual report, note 11, DKK million), before hedging; after hedging the exposure is in euro (table 3). Gold and the IMF position are separate items.

source.title: Danmarks Nationalbank, Annual Report 2025

DNK.note_no: Fordringer på utlandet etter valuta (årsrapportens note 11, millioner kroner), før sikring; etter sikring er eksponeringen i euro (tabell 3). Gullet og IMF-posisjonen er egne poster.

FIN.note: Securities of non-euro-area residents in foreign currency (note 2.2 of the financial statements, EUR 6,816 million); the SDR holding, fund investments and euro-area issuers' foreign-currency paper are outside the split.

source.title: Bank of Finland, Financial Statements 2025, note 2.2

FIN.note_no: Verdipapirer fra utstedere utenfor euroområdet i utenlandsk valuta (regnskapets note 2.2, 6 816 millioner euro); SDR-beholdningen, fondsandelene og euroområdeutstederes papirer i utenlandsk valuta er utenfor fordelingen.

ISL.note: Total foreign-denominated assets by currency, computed from note 8 of the annual report (ISK thousands).

source.title: Central Bank of Iceland, Annual Report 2025

ISL.note_no: Samlede eiendeler i utenlandsk valuta per valuta, regnet ut fra note 8 i årsrapporten (tusen kroner).

CHE.note: Currency allocation of the foreign exchange reserves including derivatives; 'other' is mainly Australian dollar, renminbi, Danish krone, Hong Kong dollar, won, Swedish krona and Singapore dollar.

source.title: Swiss National Bank, Breakdown of investments at end of Q3 2026

CHE.note_no: Valutafordelingen av valutareservene medregnet derivater; «andre» er i hovedsak australske dollar, renminbi, danske kroner, Hongkong-dollar, won, svenske kroner og Singapore-dollar.

EZB.note: Net foreign currency holdings from note 2.2 of the annual accounts (USD 53,316 million, JPY 1,715,294 million, CNY 4,802 million) converted at the accounts' year-end rates. The accounts' text puts the dollar at 78 per cent of the foreign currency holdings on a wider denominator; the yen and renminbi shares are not printed.

source.title: ECB, Annual Accounts 2025

EZB.note_no: Netto beholdninger i utenlandsk valuta fra årsregnskapets note 2.2 (53 316 millioner dollar, 1 715 294 millioner yen, 4 802 millioner renminbi) omregnet til regnskapets kurser ved årsslutt. Regnskapsteksten setter dollaren til 78 prosent av valutabeholdningene på et bredere grunnlag; yen- og renminbiandelene er ikke oppgitt.

DEU.note: Balances with banks, security investments and other external assets in foreign currency (annual accounts, asset sub-item 2.2, EUR 31,851 million), computed from the amounts by currency; the gold and the IMF position are separate and larger.

source.title: Deutsche Bundesbank, Annual Report 2025, annual accounts

DEU.note_no: Tilgodehavender hos banker, verdipapirer og andre utenlandske fordringer i utenlandsk valuta (årsregnskapet, aktivapost 2.2, 31 851 millioner euro), regnet ut fra beløpene per valuta; gullet og IMF-posisjonen er egne og større poster.

ITA.note: Net foreign currency assets; 'other' includes the net IMF and SDR position (14 per cent).

source.title: Banca d'Italia, Bilancio di esercizio 2025, figure 9

ITA.note_no: Netto fordringer i utenlandsk valuta; «andre» omfatter netto IMF- og SDR-posisjon (14 prosent).

CZE.note: Currency allocation of the international reserves including gold (table 3); 'other' is Swedish krona (0.9) and the SDR holding (0.4). Equities are about 30 per cent of the reserves. The bank notes the shares need not sum to 100 because of rounding.

source.title: Czech National Bank, Information on the international reserves as of 30 September 2026

CZE.note_no: Valutafordelingen av de internasjonale reservene medregnet gull (tabell 3); «andre» er svenske kroner (0,9) og SDR-beholdningen (0,4). Aksjer er om lag 30 prosent av reservene. Banken opplyser at andelene ikke nødvendigvis summerer seg til 100 på grunn av avrunding.

POL.note: Strategic currency structure of the reserves excluding gold, from the annual activity report; 'other' is Norwegian krone (5) and New Zealand dollar (3). The report could not be opened by the automated checks (the site demands a browser), so the figures rest on the Polish Press Agency's account of it and are shown in the table only until checked by hand.

source.title: NBP, Sprawozdanie z działalności NBP w 2024 roku

POL.note_no: Strategisk valutastruktur for reservene uten gull, fra årsrapporten om virksomheten; «andre» er norske kroner (5) og newzealandske dollar (3). Rapporten lot seg ikke åpne maskinelt (nettstedet krever en nettleser), så tallene bygger på det polske nyhetsbyrået PAPs gjengivelse og vises bare i tabellen til de er kontrollert for hånd.

ROU.note: Chart 10.2 of the annual report; the strategic ranges are euro 40 to 75, dollar 10 to 35, other at most 35 per cent.

source.title: National Bank of Romania, Annual Report 2024

ROU.note_no: Figur 10.2 i årsrapporten; de strategiske intervallene er euro 40 til 75, dollar 10 til 35, andre høyst 35 prosent.

SRB.note: Foreign exchange reserves excluding gold (13 per cent of the gross reserves); 'other' is the SDR holding (0.28) and other currencies (0.66). The English report dates the sentence 31 December 2023 by mistake; the 2023 report gives different end-2023 figures (euro 77.2, dollar 19.0).

source.title: National Bank of Serbia, Annual Report on Activities and Results 2024

SRB.note_no: Valutareserver uten gull (13 prosent av bruttoreservene); «andre» er SDR-beholdningen (0,28) og andre valutaer (0,66). Den engelske rapporten daterer setningen feilaktig til 31. desember 2023; rapporten for 2023 gir andre tall for utgangen av 2023 (euro 77,2, dollar 19,0).

ISR.note: The currency benchmark at the beginning of 2024 (figure 5), set by the Monetary Committee and unchanged through the year; the report gives no actual holdings by currency.

source.title: Bank of Israel, Investment of the Foreign Exchange Reserves, Annual Report 2024

ISR.note_no: Valutareferansen ved inngangen til 2024 (figur 5), fastsatt av den pengepolitiske komiteen og uendret gjennom året; rapporten oppgir ingen faktisk beholdning per valuta.

CAN.institution: Department of Finance and Bank of Canada (Exchange Fund Account)
CAN.note: Liquid reserves at market value; the policy requires at least half in dollars and a mix that matches the foreign-currency debt. The monthly release of October 2026 gives USD 65.7, EUR 17.0, GBP 9.5, JPY 7.7.

source.title: Report on the Management of Canada's Official International Reserves 2025-26

CAN.note_no: Likvide reserver til markedsverdi; retningslinjene krever minst halvparten i dollar og en sammensetning som svarer til valutagjelden. Månedsrapporten for oktober 2026 gir USD 65,7, EUR 17,0, GBP 9,5, JPY 7,7.

USA.institution: US Treasury (Exchange Stabilization Fund) and Federal Reserve (System Open Market Account)
USA.note: The foreign currency portfolios hold only euro and yen; gold and SDRs dominate the headline reserves and are outside this split.

source.title: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Treasury and Federal Reserve Foreign Exchange Operations, July to September 2026, tables 1 and 2

USA.note_no: Valutaporteføljene holder bare euro og yen; gull og SDR dominerer de samlede reservene og er utenfor fordelingen.

MEX.note: Net foreign currency position by currency from the audited financial statements, a balance-sheet exposure including forwards, not a reserve allocation; 'other' includes the SDR holding.

source.title: Banco de México, Estados Financieros 2025, nota 4m

MEX.note_no: Netto valutaposisjon per valuta fra det reviderte regnskapet, en balanseeksponering medregnet terminer, ikke en reserveallokering; «andre» omfatter SDR-beholdningen.

BRA.note: Year-end allocation of the international reserves; the benchmark hedges the currency mix of the external debt. The report carries a ten-year table (dollar 83 per cent in 2016).

source.title: Banco Central do Brasil, International Reserves Management Report 2026

BRA.note_no: Fordelingen av de internasjonale reservene ved årsslutt; referanseporteføljen sikrer valutasammensetningen i utenlandsgjelden. Rapporten har en tiårstabell (dollar 83 prosent i 2016).

CHL.note: Currency composition of the investment portfolio (financial statements 2025, table 5.5); the benchmark for it is USD 74, CNY 6, CAD 6, AUD 5, GBP 3, EUR 3, KRW 3 (table 5.1), and the bank's whole-balance-sheet net currency exposure is USD 73, CNY 6, CAD 6, AUD 5, GBP 3, EUR 3, other 4 (table 5.2).

source.title: Banco Central de Chile, Estados Financieros 2025, nota 5

CHL.note_no: Valutasammensetningen i investeringsporteføljen (regnskapet 2025, tabell 5.5); referansen for den er USD 74, CNY 6, CAD 6, AUD 5, GBP 3, EUR 3, KRW 3 (tabell 5.1), og bankens netto valutaeksponering for hele balansen er USD 73, CNY 6, CAD 6, AUD 5, GBP 3, EUR 3, andre 4 (tabell 5.2).

COL.note: The investment portfolio, 92.4 per cent of the net reserves (chart 4 of the report; the figures are dated 31 December 2024).

source.title: Banco de la República, Informe de Administración de las Reservas Internacionales 2025

COL.note_no: Investeringsporteføljen, 92,4 prosent av nettoreservene (figur 4 i rapporten; tallene er per 31. desember 2024).

PER.institution: Banco Central de Reserva del Perú
PER.note: Effective currency exposure of the foreign exchange position (the net position, US$68.6 bn, not the gross reserves); the other currencies are not itemised.

source.title: BCRP, Nota de Estudios 79-2026

PER.note_no: Effektiv valutaeksponering i valutaposisjonen (nettoposisjonen, 68,6 mrd. US$, ikke bruttoreservene); de andre valutaene er ikke spesifisert.

AUS.note: Benchmark allocation; 'other' is the Korean won. In 2024-25 the dollar weight was cut from 55 to 45 and the euro raised from 20 to 30. Gold is managed outside the benchmark.

source.title: Reserve Bank of Australia, Annual Report 2026, table 2.2.4

AUS.note_no: Referanseallokering; «andre» er koreanske won. I 2024–25 ble dollarvekten satt ned fra 55 til 45 og euro opp fra 20 til 30. Gullet forvaltes utenfor referansen.

NZL.note: The unhedged part of the reserves (NZ$7.8 bn of a total capacity of NZ$27 bn); the benchmark is USD 50, EUR 15, GBP 15, CAD 10, AUD 10.

source.title: Reserve Bank of New Zealand, Annual Report 2026, note 13

NZL.note_no: Den usikrede delen av reservene (7,8 mrd. NZD av en samlet kapasitet på 27 mrd.); referansen er USD 50, EUR 15, GBP 15, CAD 10, AUD 10.

KOR.note: Only the dollar share is published (2019 to 2025: 69.1, 67.7, 68.3, 72.0, 70.9, 71.9, 69.5).

source.title: Bank of Korea, Annual Report 2025, table II-15

HKG.note: Whole Exchange Fund including forwards; 'other' is the Hong Kong dollar (5.8) and mainly euro, renminbi, sterling and yen.

source.title: HKMA, Annual Report 2025, Reserves Management, table 3

HKG.note_no: Hele Exchange Fund medregnet terminer; «andre» er Hongkong-dollar (5,8) og i hovedsak euro, renminbi, pund og yen.

CHN.note: Only the dollar share was ever disclosed: 55 per cent for 2019 in box 5 of the 2023 annual report (the chart gives the year only), and 79 per cent for 1995 and 58 per cent for 2014 in box 4 of the 2018 annual report (https://www.safe.gov.cn/en/file/file/20190905/50f4bb211064441caaa732eb708e1e1c.pdf); the 2024 and 2025 reports carry no such box. The IMF template gives the split into SDR-basket and other currencies.

source.title: SAFE, Annual Report 2023, box 5

CHN.note_no: Bare dollarandelen ble noen gang oppgitt: 55 prosent for 2019 i ramme 5 i årsrapporten for 2023 (figuren oppgir bare året), og 79 prosent for 1995 og 58 prosent for 2014 i ramme 4 i årsrapporten for 2018 (https://www.safe.gov.cn/en/file/file/20190905/50f4bb211064441caaa732eb708e1e1c.pdf); rapportene for 2024 og 2025 har ingen slik ramme. IMFs reservemal gir fordelingen mellom SDR-kurvens valutaer og andre.

RUS.note: The quarterly series was suspended on 30 March 2022; later annual reports say the liquid assets are now renminbi, gold and cash.

source.title: Bank of Russia, Annual Report 2021, chart 32

RUS.note_no: Kvartalsserien ble stanset 30. mars 2022; senere årsrapporter sier at de likvide aktivaene nå er renminbi, gull og kontanter.

ZAF.note: Concentration-risk note of the financial statements on the gold and foreign exchange reserves; 'other' includes the SDR holding.

source.title: South African Reserve Bank, Annual Report 2025/26, group financial statements, note 29.1.3

ZAF.note_no: Note om konsentrasjonsrisiko i regnskapet, for gull- og valutareservene; «andre» omfatter SDR-beholdningen.

PHL.note: Foreign currency financial assets at carrying amounts by currency (financial statements 2025, note 3.1.1), with the row of fine troy ounces (gold) left out; 'other' is almost entirely the SDR holding. With gold included the dollar share would be 80.7 per cent.

source.title: BSP, Audited Financial Statements 2025, note 3.1.1

PHL.note_no: Finansielle eiendeler i utenlandsk valuta til bokført verdi per valuta (regnskapet 2025, note 3.1.1), uten raden med troy-unser (gull); «andre» er nesten bare SDR-beholdningen. Med gull medregnet ville dollarandelen vært 80,7 prosent.

TUR.institution: Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye
TUR.note: From the BOFIT dataset, whose 2023 row for Türkiye sums to 98.8, not 100; the central bank itself publishes no current currency split.

source.title: Laser, Mihailov and Weidner, BOFIT Policy Brief 6/2024, data appendix

TUR.note_no: Fra BOFIT-datasettet, der raden for Tyrkia 2023 summerer seg til 98,8, ikke 100; sentralbanken selv publiserer ingen aktuell valutafordeling.

source.title: Laser, Mihailov and Weidner, BOFIT Policy Brief 6/2024, data appendix
